verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a management portal for managing address books and devices and monitoring sessions, plus organization-level user management with roles and permissions. That covers the shared console and address-book organization. Nothing shows access policies scoped per group of machines or users; the evidence describes roles and permissions only in general terms. The CLI and REST API items cover deployment and client listing, not grouping or policies, and community items are off-topic. Missing for 10: explicit per-group access policies, details on shared address-book permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
